targets.rawSql: SELECT compliance_percentage AS value FROM compliance_results WHERE policy_name = 'NERC CIP' ORDER BY evaluation_timestamp DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT compliance_percentage AS value FROM compliance_results WHERE policy_name = 'NERC CIP-015 INSM' ORDER BY evaluation_timestamp DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT compliance_percentage AS value FROM compliance_results WHERE policy_name = 'OpenShift Compliance Operator — ocp4-nerc-cip' ORDER BY evaluation_timestamp DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT CASE WHEN compliant THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS value FROM compliance_results WHERE policy_name = 'OpenShift CIP-010 Drift — ocp4-nerc-cip' ORDER BY evaluation_timestamp DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Compliance Score Trend — AAC vs Compliance Operator

targets.rawSql: SELECT evaluation_timestamp AS time, policy_name AS metric, compliance_percentage AS value FROM compliance_results WHERE policy_name IN ('NERC CIP','NERC CIP-015 INSM','OpenShift Compliance Operator — ocp4-nerc-cip') AND $__timeFilter(evaluation_timestamp) ORDER BY evaluation_timestamp

SELECT evaluation_timestamp AS time, policy_name AS metric, failed_controls AS value FROM compliance_results WHERE policy_name IN ('NERC CIP','NERC CIP-015 INSM','OpenShift Compliance Operator — ocp4-nerc-cip') AND $__timeFilter(evaluation_timestamp) ORDER BY evaluation_timestamp

SELECT DISTINCT ON (policy_name) policy_name AS "Source", compliance_percentage AS "Compliance %", passed_controls AS "Passed", failed_controls AS "Failed", compliant AS "Compliant", evaluation_timestamp AS "Last Run" FROM compliance_results WHERE policy_name IN ('NERC CIP','NERC CIP-015 INSM','OpenShift Compliance Operator — ocp4-nerc-cip') ORDER BY policy_name, evaluation_timestamp DESC

panels.title: OpenShift Compliance Operator — Failing CIP Controls (latest)

targets.rawSql: SELECT v->>'control' AS "CIP Control", v->>'check' AS "Check", v->>'severity' AS "Severity" FROM (SELECT violations FROM compliance_results WHERE policy_name = 'OpenShift Compliance Operator — ocp4-nerc-cip' ORDER BY evaluation_timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) x, jsonb_array_elements(x.violations) v

panels.title: Baseline of Record vs Current (CIP-010 R1/R2)

targets.rawSql: (SELECT 'Baseline (authorized)' AS "Snapshot", total_controls AS "Checks", passed_controls AS "PASS at baseline", failed_controls AS "FAIL at baseline", NULL::int AS "Drift findings", NULL::text AS "Change authorization", evaluation_timestamp AS "Captured" FROM compliance_results WHERE policy_name = 'OpenShift CIP-010 Baseline — ocp4-nerc-cip' ORDER BY evaluation_timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) UNION ALL (SELECT 'Current vs baseline', total_controls, NULL::int, NULL::int, (jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(metadata->'regressions','[]'::jsonb)) + jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(metadata->'config_drift','[]'::jsonb)) + jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(metadata->'new_failures','[]'::jsonb)))::int, CASE WHEN (jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(metadata->'regressions','[]'::jsonb)) + jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(metadata->'config_drift','[]'::jsonb)) + jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(metadata->'new_failures','[]'::jsonb))) = 0 THEN 'no drift' WHEN COALESCE(metadata->>'change_ticket','') = '' THEN 'UNAUDITED' ELSE metadata->>'change_ticket' END, evaluation_timestamp FROM compliance_results WHERE policy_name = 'OpenShift CIP-010 Drift — ocp4-nerc-cip' ORDER BY evaluation_timestamp DESC LIMIT 1)
